notes: SAME-SITE CHECK: verified this is NOT identical to SR7 (Anthropologie Home, US, already extracted). anthropologie.com serves a genuinely separate UK storefront at /en-gb/ with its own sitemapindex (https://www.anthropologie.com/en-gb/sitemapindex.xml, separate from the US one), GBP pricing, a different top-nav structure ('Home & Decor' + separate 'Furniture' vs the US's combined 'Home & Furniture'), different category slugs (e.g. UK 'bathroom-textiles' vs US 'bathroom-bathmats'/'bathroom-bath-towels' split), and different product counts throughout - this matches what the Furniture worker (f126.json) already independently confirmed for this same SR/company via the GB locale. A full research pass was therefore run on the /en-gb/ catalog rather than reusing SR7's rows. ACCESS: robots.txt (https://www.anthropologie.com/robots.txt, fetched via headed Playwright since direct HTTP was blocked - see below) has 'User-agent: * / Allow: /' with only /orchestration/, /api/, /cgi-bin/, /blog/wp-content/, /homepage, /*search?, /claims, /order-tracking, /order/, /password/reset disallowed and no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entry - no tier is blocked by robots.txt. TIER ESCALATION: tier (a) direct HTTP (curl with a Chrome UA, then curl_cffi impersonate=chrome120) got HTTP 403 with a DataDome CAPTCHA page (geo.captcha-delivery.com) on every request, including robots.txt. Tier (b) Playwright headless (default launch, Chrome UA) also hit the DataDome CAPTCHA wall (403, iframe challenge). Escalated to Playwright headed with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled per the brief's tier (b) instruction - this succeeded (HTTP 200, real page content, locale=en-GB) and was used for the entire research pass. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed (and is disconnected per the brief). TREE METHOD: union of (1) the en-GB categories sitemap (https://www.anthropologie.com/en-gb/categories_sitemap.xml, 1091 category slugs, fetched via Playwright response.text() to get raw XML rather than the browser's XML-viewer-wrapped HTML) filtered for textile/storage keywords, and (2) the 'Home & Decor' mega-nav hub page (https://www.anthropologie.com/en-gb/home, itself reached via the header nav) which lists Bathroom Textiles, Bedding, Curtains, Cushions & Throws, Furniture, Home Decor, Kitchen & Dining, Lighting, Mirrors, Rugs, Soft Furnishings, Wall Art as parallel top-level entries with no deeper nesting (mirrors the Furniture worker's finding that this site's GB nav is flat, no second level - mouse-hover flyout automation was attempted first via Playwright hover/mouse.move but the site's flyout did not render into the DOM on hover in headless-controlled Chrome, so the /en-gb/home hub page and /en-gb/kitchen-dining-entertaining hub page were used as the reliable source of the sub-nav instead, each cross-checked against the categories sitemap). QTY METHOD: rendered 'N products' header text on each category listing page, read via page.inner_text('body') + regex, taken verbatim once (single read per URL; DataDome-sensitive so pages were not re-fetched twice as SR7 did). Canonical URL and H1 were checked on every leaf. SOFT FURNISHINGS EXCLUDED AS PARENT/AGGREGATE: /en-gb/soft-furnishings ('Soft Furnishings', 857 products) contains the union of Bedding, Curtains, Cushions & Throws, Rugs, Doormats and Bathroom Textiles product types (verified by product-title sampling: bedspreads, duvet covers, curtains, cushions, rugs, bath mats, shower curtains, towels all appear on it) - since all of those exist as their own valid, more specific navigational categories (rule: do not record a parent URL when valid subcategories exist), Soft Furnishings itself was not recorded as a row to avoid double-counting; its children are recorded individually instead. DUPLICATE DROPPED: /en-gb/kitchen-tablecloths-linens (a promotional tile link, H1 'Table Linens') canonicalizes to and is byte-identical in count to /en-gb/linens-tableware (82 products) - kept once, under linens-tableware. /en-gb/soft-furnishings-rugs redirects/canonicalizes to /en-gb/rugs (same 145-product listing, H1 'Rugs') - recorded once under the canonical /en-gb/rugs URL. EXCLUDED (neither Textile nor Storage): Lighting (/en-gb/home-lighting), Mirrors (/en-gb/decor-mirrors), Wall Art/Prints/Paintings (/en-gb/artwork), Candles & Home Fragrance (/en-gb/candles), Books/Stationery/Games, Glassware & Bar, Gourmet Food & Drink, Mugs & Teacups, Dinnerware, Serveware & Entertaining, Cooking Utensils & Appliances - Kitchen & Dining/Decorative-Accessories territory, not textile/storage; curtain-hardware (/en-gb/curtain-hardware) - hardware per textile.md 5; bathroom-hardware (/en-gb/bathroom-hardware, 134 products, 'Towel Rails & More' - toilet-roll holders/towel rings/rails/hooks) - fixtures/hardware, not storage, matches SR7's precedent of excluding US 'Bath Hardware'; furniture-storage (/en-gb/furniture-storage, 61 products, 'Bedside Tables & Side Tables') and furniture-bookcases-storage (/en-gb/furniture-bookcases-storage, 119 products, nav label 'Cabinets & Storage', H1 'Storage') - both sit explicitly under this site's own Furniture department nav and were already captured as Furniture rows in f126.json (storage.md 21/27: prefer the site's own Furniture placement) - not re-classified here; room-wall-decor-shelves (/en-gb/room-wall-decor-shelves, 97 products, title 'Decorative Shelves & Brackets', H1 'Shelves & Brackets') - sits under the Home Decor/Wall Decor branch, is decorative wall shelves/brackets not storage furniture, per storage.md 18 belongs to Wall Decor (already-validated file, not touched); shop-by-room-bathroom (canonical of /en-gb/bathroom, 273 products, H1 'Shop by Room: Bathroom') and the other shop-by-room-* curation pages (bedroom/living-room/dining-room/office/small-spaces/uni-room) - cross-category room 'shop the look' curations mixing furniture, mirrors, lighting, vanities and a handful of towels/shower-curtains/one rattan hamper already covered by the dedicated Bathroom Textiles/Decorative Storage Baskets rows - excluded as promotional landing pages, matching the Furniture worker's exclusion of the same 'Shop by Room' column; kids-collection (/en-gb/kids-collection, 64 products) - inspected via product-title sample, is soft-toys/party-candles/birthday-decor, no bedding/textile/storage items found, excluded; all 'selected-lines-*', 'sale-*', 'new-*', 'limited-time-promotion-*' slugs found in the sitemap (selected-lines-soft-furnishings, selected-lines-rugs, selected-lines-cabinets-storage, sale-bedding, sale-soft-furnishings, new-soft-furnishings, limited-time-promotion-soft-furnishings) - promotional/marketing collection pages per rule 27, not genuine categories; garden/outdoor sitemap entries (garden-outdoor-furniture, garden-outdoor-pots, outdoor-dining-curation) are furniture/planters, no outdoor textile or outdoor storage category exists on this locale; no dedicated Laundry, Pantry, Office, or Closet storage category exists anywhere in the GB nav or sitemap (shop-lollys-laundry is a brand-collab product collection, not a laundry-storage category). STORAGE INCLUDED: decor-baskets (/en-gb/decor-baskets, 20 products, page title 'Decorative Storage Baskets', H1 'Baskets') - site's own title explicitly names it a storage category (storage.md 5/23); kitchen-food-storage-containers (/en-gb/kitchen-food-storage-containers, 13 products, title 'Food Storage, Canisters & Containers', H1 'Food Storage') - storage.md 13 explicit include.
